incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 502/504s on api-gateway (eu-west-1) — spike started ~1719902400. Route: /v1/generate. Error rate 35% over 5m. Pager: @alice_oc oncall.
alice_oc: seeing it in datadog - 502s + timeouts. TL;DR: requests hitting backend pods are hanging, high connection count on edge LB.
ben_sre: I can confirm. kc top shows many connections in CLOSE_WAIT on edge-proxies. Cpu ~45%, conn queue growth.
carla_edge: edge logs show rapid 502 fanout to upstreams, retries happening. One backend service A is returning 504s intermittently, then gateway surfaces 502s.
derek_net: checking upstream health and pool exhaustion. Early hypothesis: sudden long-lived upstream responses -> connection pool depletion -> gateway returns 502.
emma_cs: customer impact: several paying customers report failed calls to chat endpoints. SLO alerts firing, some 3rd-party webhooks backed up.
alice_oc: action list: 1) open temporary circuit to backend A, 2) shift 25% traffic to eu-central fallback pool, 3) bump gateway connection pool size + enable fast fail for retries. Who can run shifts?
ben_sre: I’ll run traffic shift via traffic-manager: `tm shift --from eu-west --to eu-central --pct 25 --reason "502 spike"`
carla_edge: recommend enabling per-route circuit breaker: `circuit.add --route /v1/generate --threshold 20% --window 60s` — will prevent fanout.
derek_net: increasing LB max connections now. Pushing config: `edgectl set conn-limit 12000` — rolling update started. Expect ~30s for propagate.
emma_cs: notifying affected customers via status page draft: "We're investigating increased 5xx rates in EU; mitigations in progress." Want me to post?
alice_oc: yes, post with current mitigation steps. Ben — confirm when traffic shift completes.
ben_sre: traffic-manager reports shift completed at ~1719902590. Monitoring.
carla_edge: circuits tripped for backend A at 1719902610; error rate dropped from 35% -> 8% over 5m.
derek_net: LB conn growth stabilized after conn-limit bump. CLOSE_WAIT count falling.
emma_cs: posted status update (link: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/171990). Customers replied acknowledging reduced impact.
alice_oc: good. Next: follow-up tasks — root cause RCA, roll back conn-limit if safe, tune retry backoff to avoid cascading retries. Assign owners.
ben_sre: I'll own temporary config + rollback plan.
carla_edge: I'll own circuit policy and evaluate upstream health patterns.
derek_net: I'll dig into TCP traces with net team for long-lived responses.
emma_cs: I'll collect customer reports and update slack thread for any escalations.
alice_oc: handing off to daytime oncall @ben_sre for long-term monitoring. Oncall handoff notes: mitigations active, traffic shifted, circuits enabled, status posted.
ben_sre: taking handoff. Will keep thread updated. :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged closed to pager (no active page) — monitoring only.
